topic: Day 126 — reel — A small finished act of purpose beats a big unstarted plan for one
text:
A finished
small thing
beats an
unstarted [plan].
caption:
A plan produces nothing until it's executed, no matter how good it is. The comparison favours the smaller finished version every time.
